referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the electricity production in Switzerland and from imports, the transmission network as well as direct SF6-emissions to air. Electricity losses during low-voltage transmission and transformation from medium-voltage are accounted for.

geography.text: Data apply to public and self producers. Geographical classification according to IEA. Transmission network, losses and emissions are taken from Itten, Frischknecht and Stucki (2014): LCI of Electricity Mixes and Grid.

technology.text: Average technology used to distribute electricity. Includes underground and overhead lines, as well as air- and SF6-insulated medium-to-low voltage switching stations. Electricity production according to related datasets
